title: Membership E-commerce Website
description:
A corporate site selling hair-care products and offering training courses. Green tones and natural elements carry the brand's commitment to natural ingredients.
Product purchase and course registration were merged into one seamless flow.
I defined the information architecture and the full user journey, took it from wireframes to a polished prototype, implemented the responsive front end, and iterated on user feedback.
